q: What does this Bible recommend as the starting point before adopting a framework?
explain: Start simple and adopt a framework when it removes real work.

q: What is the safest first choice when you are not sure you need a framework?
options: Write the small loop yourself and adopt a framework when a specific pain appears
explain: Start simple; add abstraction for real needs.

q: Which assets stay portable across frameworks?
options: Prompts, tool definitions, MCP servers, eval sets and OpenTelemetry traces

q: What does an agent SDK package?
options: A working harness: loop, tools, context management, permissions, tracing
explain: More than a client library, less than a framework.
